Odisha Approves 27 Industrial Projects Worth Over ₹2.45 Lakh Crore

Odisha's High Level Clearance Authority (HLCA) has approved 27 industrial projects across 15 districts, with an estimated investment of ₹2.45 lakh crore to ₹2.47 lakh crore. These projects are expected to generate over 50,000 jobs in various industrial sectors. The Odisha BJP unit has lauded the clearance of these projects.
